pages.title: Judy Hopps Writing Case Notes with Her Carrot Recorder Pen at Her Police Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps writes case notes with her carrot recorder pen at her police desk in this printable coloring page, leaning over an open notebook in uniform. A desk lamp, pencil cup, and stacked documents surround her writing area. The coloring sheet leaves broad notebook pages beside smaller badge, buckle, and pen details.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Using Her Police Radio While Patrolling Savanna Central Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps using her police radio while patrolling Savanna Central, walking between city buildings with the handheld device near her mouth. A tall streetlamp and planted border line the pavement behind her. Her uniform badge, knee pads, and belt pouches provide smaller details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Receiving Her Badge From Bellwether at Her Police Academy Graduation Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps receives her badge from Bellwether at her police academy graduation in this printable coloring page, standing with clasped paws as Bellwether pins the shield. Both wear formal jackets, and Bellwether has large round glasses. A podium microphone and draped stage decorations frame the figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Judy Hopps Visiting Her Parents' Carrot Booth at the Carrot Days Festival Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Judy Hopps visiting her parents' carrot booth at the Carrot Days Festival, wearing a small police outfit and badge cap. Her parents stand behind baskets of carrots beneath triangular flags. The coloring sheet includes leafy carrot tops, a checked shirt, wooden stall panels, and a distant tent.

pages.title: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde Riding Together in Their Zpd Patrol Car Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde ride together in their ZPD patrol car in this printable coloring page, with Judy holding the steering wheel beside uniformed Nick. The compact vehicle has a roof light bar and front bumper guard. Broad hood panels, tire outlines, city towers, and small badges fill the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Questioning the Jaguar Manchas at His Rainforest District Apartment Door Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Judy Hopps questioning the jaguar Manchas at his Rainforest District apartment door, holding a spiral notepad and pencil while looking up at him. Manchas wears an open short-sleeved shirt and shorts. Hanging vines, a wall lantern, balcony rails, and his outlined spots detail the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Searching a Corridor at Cliffside Asylum with Her Phone's Flashlight Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps searches a corridor at Cliffside Asylum with her phone's flashlight in this printable coloring page, directing an outlined beam toward the doors beside her. Cracked walls, exposed pipes, and a wheeled hospital bed establish the interior. The coloring sheet combines broad uniform areas with narrow rails, floor tiles, and peeling wall shapes.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Apologizing to Nick Wilde Beneath the Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps apologizing to Nick Wilde beneath the bridge, clasping her paws while looking up at him beside the waterfront path. Nick stands with his paws in his pockets and wears a striped tie. Curving bridge supports, a distant skyline, and paving lines frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Recording Bellwether's Confession Beside a Museum Diorama Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps records Bellwether's confession beside a museum diorama in this printable coloring page, holding her carrot recorder while Bellwether gestures with both hooves beneath her glasses. A dinosaur skeleton rises above rocks and plants behind a display barrier. The coloring sheet includes small fossil bones, uniform equipment, and broad jacket panels.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Handing Nick Wilde a Carrot Pen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps giving Nick Wilde her carrot recorder pen after his police academy graduation, with both characters dressed in ceremonial uniforms. Their braided shoulder cords and belts surround the small pen exchange. Tossed caps, crowd silhouettes, and a shield-fronted podium add background shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde Dancing at Gazelle's Outdoor Concert Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde dance at Gazelle's outdoor concert in this printable coloring page, lifting their paws and bending their knees in front of the stage. Nick wears a floral shirt and striped tie beside uniformed Judy. Speakers, spotlights, palm trees, and cheering crowd silhouettes add background sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde Standing Back to Back in Front of the Zootopia Skyline Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde standing back to back in front of the Zootopia skyline, with Judy holding her carrot recorder. Nick wears his collared shirt and striped tie beside her police uniform. Curved towers, an elevated bridge, and waterfront lines add architectural details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde Wearing Formal Gala Outfits in the Zootennial Ballroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde wear formal gala outfits in the Zootennial ballroom in this printable coloring page, standing together beneath a chandelier and high arches. Judy has a flower crown and flowing gown, while Nick wears a bow tie and vest. Floral arrangements and draped curtains surround the coloring sheet's larger clothing sections.

pages.title: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde in Hats on a Dock Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde wearing undercover hats while meeting Nibbles Maplestick on the Marsh Market dock, surrounded by water and reeds. Nibbles wears a brimmed hat and many-pocketed vest beside their jackets. Rope-wrapped posts, dock planks, and her crosshatched tail add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Waving in an Off-Shoulder Top Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Judy Hopps waving with a cheerful smile, wearing a striped off-shoulder top and shorts, surrounded by floating hearts and sparkles.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Holding a Large Feather Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps looking up at a large feather she holds in one paw, with upright ears, a police uniform, and a utility belt.

pages.title: Judy Hopps in a Flowing Ruffled Gown Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Judy Hopps posing in an elegant layered gown with flowing ruffles, a flower-decorated hair bun, wide eyes, and a rose on her shoulder.

pages.title: Relaxing Judy Hopps Pajamas Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Judy Hopps reclining against a couch in carrot-patterned pajamas, holding a coffee mug labeled BYE and a TV remote. Nearby sits a container of instant noodles against floral pillows. Thick outlines make this sheet great for shading with alcohol markers or colored pencils.

pages.title: Zootopia Judy Hopps at Farmers Market Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable page is ready with a scene featuring zootopia judy hopps at farmers market. Works well for party activities, family time, or after school fun. Encourages creative exploration through fun coloring sessions. Clean outlines keep the page clear and enjoyable to finish.
